title: CWP/19111/2025 of JASWANT SINGH Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ANOTHER
text:
107 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision :22.08.2025 Jaswant Singh …Petitioner Versus State of Haryana and Another ….Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE TRIBHUVAN DAHIYA Present: Mr. Jitender Sharma, Advocate for the petitioner. Ms. Tanushree Gupta, Senior Deputy Advocate General, Haryana. TRIBHUVAN DAHIYA, J. (ORAL) The petition has been filed, inter alia, seeking a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to grant the benefits of notional pay fixation and seniority to the petitioner by fixing his pay at par with juniors.

2. Learned State counsel, on instructions, contends that the petitioner’s case for grant of due benefits is under consideration with the Department, and appropriate decision thereupon will be taken by the second respondent/Director Secondary School Education within three months. She also contends that in case he is found eligible to the due benefits, the same will be released within four weeks thereafter.

3. In view of the statement made, learned counsel for the petitioner has no objection to the petition being disposed of in terms thereof.

4. Ordered accordingly.

5. In case the decision is not taken within a stipulated period, the officer concerned shall pay costs of ₹50,000 to the petitioner. (TRIBHUVAN DAHIYA) August 22, 2025 JUDGE ps
